definitions.explanation: The result of not hitting the target or not winning. The opposite of {当|あ}たり (hit, winner).
The edge or outskirts of a place, beyond the main area.

examples.japanese: くじ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外|はず}れだった。
examples.english: The lottery ticket was a miss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{外|はず}れだった。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{当|あ}たり{外|はず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。
examples.english: That restaurant is very hit or miss.

examples.japanese: {町|まち}{外|はず}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live on the outskirts of town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外|はず}れ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked to the end of the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{外|はず}れた⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a quiet cafe in a spot slightly off from the station.

notes:
{外|はず}れ is the noun form of the verb {外|はず}れる (to miss, to come off). It has two distinct meanings depending on context.

SENSE 1 — MISS/FAILURE:
Used for lotteries, predictions, and expectations that didn't come true. Opposite of ⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧ (hit, winner).
- くじ{外|はず}れ: losing lottery ticket
- ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧{外|はず}れ: wrong prediction
- {当|あ}たり{外|はず}れ: hit or miss (idiom for inconsistent quality)

SENSE 2 — OUTSKIRTS/EDGE:
Used as a suffix with place words to mean the outer edge or outskirts.
- {町|まち}{外|はず}れ: outskirts of town
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外|はず}れ: end of the road
- ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧{外|はず}れ: off-season, unseasonal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧: hit, winner, correct guess (for sense 1)
